transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I’m not trying to make a big thing of it, but things at work have been… off. I’m an interpreter and translator, and for a few months I’ve been noticing the same pattern in some project files.

It looks like certain subcontractors, and one colleague, keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory and the timestamps. Small things, but enough that it ends up looking like my quality control failed. IT says the audit trail is clean, and I understand that’s what they’re saying, but from what I’m seeing, the record has been arranged so the blame lands on me.

I know that probably sounds a bit much. I just thought it would be better to talk to someone about it properly.
Do you feel certain that your colleague is deliberately altering the records to make you look responsible?

I mean… “certain” is a strong word, and I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But yes, from what I’ve been seeing over the past few months, it does look deliberate.

It’s the same kind of small changes in the translation memory and timestamps, and they line up in a way that makes it look like my quality control failed. IT keeps saying the audit trail is clean, and I hear that, but I still feel the record has been arranged so the responsibility lands on me. One colleague and some subcontractors seem to be involved.
If someone you trust showed you clear proof that no one had changed the records, would you be able to accept that?

I’d like to think I could, yes. I mean, if it was really clear proof from someone I trust, I wouldn’t want to be stubborn or anything.

But… honestly, it would be hard for me to just drop it, because for months I’ve been seeing the same pattern in the project files. The little changes in the translation memory and timestamps, always in a way that makes my quality control look bad. And even when IT says the audit trail is clean, I still feel like the record has been arranged so the blame lands on me.

I know that may not be the “right” answer, but that’s where I’m at.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, not voices like that, when no one’s there. I haven’t noticed anything like that. Is that… the kind of thing you mean?
Before these concerns started, had you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness?

No, not that I know of. I haven’t been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness before this. I mean, I’ve had normal stresses like anyone, but nothing like a neurological condition… at least nothing anyone has told me.
Before this started, did you generally tend to suspect that other people were trying to harm, cheat, or undermine you?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, I’ve always tried to assume people are acting in good faith. Maybe I could be cautious at work, like anyone, but I wouldn’t say I generally thought people were out to harm me or cheat me.

I hope that makes sense… this feels different to me than just being a suspicious person overall.
Have these concerns about the project files and your colleague been present continuously for at least three months?

Yes… I suppose it has been at least three months. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, but it’s probably been about eleven months now, since shortly after I was put in charge of the new localization project. It hasn’t really gone away during that time.
